features.name: Merge Mode JSON Auto-Parse
features.description: Automatically parse JSON string parameters in merge mode

changes: Added isJsonString() to detect JSON-like strings
Added parseJsonIfNeeded() to safely parse JSON

unit_tests: should auto-parse JSON string parameters in merge mode
should handle deep merge with JSON string
should handle invalid JSON gracefully as string
integration_tests: should auto-parse JSON strings in merge mode

features.name: Coalesce Chain Syntax
features.description: Support ${a ?? b ?? c} syntax for fallback values

methods: resolveCoalesceChain() - new method for chain resolution
parseLiteralValue() - new method for parsing literal defaults

unit_tests: should resolve first non-null value in chain
should return literal default as last fallback
should return first value if not null
should allow chain of exactly MAX_COALESCE_REFERENCES
integration_tests: should resolve coalesce chain with first valid value
should use fallback when input is undefined
